title: 롤플레이 Q11: 4단계 전략으로 자연스러운 대화 만들기
summary: RP 세트(Q11·12·13)는 대화 실력을 보여주는 구간 — 채점관에게 '실제 대화'를 보여주는 것이 핵심. 자동응답기처럼 말하지 말 것
Q11 4단계: ①상황 짧게 설명 → ②질문 → ③상대방 답변 반응(Reaction + Repeat + Feeling) → ④나머지 질문 반복 (총 3문항, 1분 이내)
3단계 '반응' 공식: 감탄사(Reaction) + 답변 반복(Repeat) + 감정 마무리(Feeling). 예) 'Oh, that cheap?! / Only $1,000? / That's great!'
마지막 질문 전 'Oh, I almost forgot!' 를 쓰면 즉흥적이고 자연스럽게 들림. 'Oh, oh, I almost forgot!'처럼 두 번 써도 OK
3개 질문은 모두 '예스'로 받기 — 부정 답변을 상상하면 흐름이 꼬임. 모두 긍정으로 설정하고 연습
색상 물을 때는 'Do you have a pink one?' 보다 'Does it come in pink?'가 훨씬 자연스러운 표현

keyExpressions.note: 전화 통화 시작에 특히 좋음. 대면이라면 그냥 'Hi'
상황 설명은 짧고 간결하게. 길게 설명하려 하지 말 것
색상 물을 때 원어민 표현. 'Do you have a pink one?'보다 자연스러움
직접 질문보다 부드럽고 자연스러움. I was wondering if the iPhone comes with nice speakers?
마지막 질문 전에 쓰면 즉흥적·자연스럽게 들림. 'Oh, oh, I almost forgot!'도 OK
She wants to buy it, but she hasn't pulled the trigger yet.
RP 마무리 표현. 'Thank you so much for your help.'와 함께

keyExpressions.en: I don't have that much of a budget.
keyExpressions.note: 가격 질문 앞에 배경 설명으로 쓸 수 있음
Reaction + Repeat 뒤 Feeling 마무리 표현

cards.back: ①Situation (상황 짧게) → ②Question (질문) → ③React+Repeat+Feel (반응) → ④Next questions (반복)
cards.example: Hi there! I'd like to buy an iPhone X. / How much is it? / Oh, that cheap?! Only $1,000? That's great! / Actually, does it come in pink?
Hi there! I'm calling because I'd like to buy a new phone.

cards.back: Keep it short and sweet. 딱 한 문장으로.
cards.example: Hi there! I'd like to buy an iPhone X. (끝, 바로 질문으로)

cards.front: 질문 후 상대방 답변에 반응하는 3단계 공식은?
cards.example: Oh, that cheap?! (reaction) Only $1,000? (repeat) That's great! (feeling)
Oh nice! So it does come in pink? That's great!

cards.front: 마지막 질문 전에 즉흥적으로 보이게 하는 표현은?
cards.back: Oh, I almost forgot! / Oh, oh, I almost forgot!
cards.example: Oh, I almost forgot! I really love listening to music — I was wondering if the iPhone comes with good speakers?
I was wondering if the iPhone X comes with nice speakers?

cards.front: 아직 구매를 결정 안 했다 (결정을 내리다) — 영어로?
cards.back: She hasn't pulled the trigger yet.
cards.example: I want to buy it, but I haven't pulled the trigger yet.

cards.front: RP 마무리 감사 인사 두 가지는?
cards.back: Thank you so much for your help! / I really appreciate the help.
cards.example: I really appreciate the help. I'll stop by tomorrow!

cards.back: I don't have that much of a budget.
cards.example: I don't have that much of a budget, so I was wondering how much the iPhone X is.
